sentences.Synne tar sykepleierutdanning på univers: Synne is training as a nurse at the university in Trondheim.
sentences.Hun går på forelesninger, og hun sitter: She goes to lectures, and she sits at the university reading, but she also often sits in her room working.
sentences.I løpet av studiet skal hun levere mange: During her studies she has to hand in lots of assignments on different topics.
sentences.Oppgavene er obligatoriske, og hun jobbe: The assignments are compulsory, and she works hard on her assignments.
sentences.Annenhver helg jobber hun på et sykehjem: Every other weekend she works at a nursing home.
sentences.I disse helgene er hun ikke så mye samme: On those weekends she doesn't spend much time with her friends, but it is important for her to earn some extra money on top of her student loan.
sentences.Synne bor i kollektiv sammen med tre and: Synne lives in a shared flat with three other girls.
They share a living room, kitchen and bathroom.
sentences.Det er litt trangt, men de bor ganske bi: It's a bit cramped, but they live quite cheaply.
sentences.Noen ganger blir det veldig rotete i lei: Sometimes the flat gets very messy, and they take turns tidying and cleaning.
sentences.Av og til ringer Synne til Viola. Hun sa: Now and then Synne rings Viola. She misses her new friend, whom she got to know when she was living at home.
sentences.Hun håper at Viola fortsatt trives som a: She hopes that Viola is still happy as an au pair, and that she can come and visit her in Trondheim soon.
sentences.Statens lånekasse for utdanning gir økon: The Norwegian State Educational Loan Fund gives financial support for education.
You can apply for both grants and loans.
sentences.Stipendet er penger som du får, men stud: The grant is money you get, but you have to pay back the student loan.
sentences.De som ikke fullfører studiet, må også b: Those who do not complete their studies also have to pay back part of their grant.
